sentences.en: One day, Pip went to Jaggers's office, and Wemmick looked at him with a stern face.

sentences.en: "Pip, you loved her, and I saw it, and I did not stop it."

sentences.en: Miss Havisham went down on the floor, and she held up her hands.

sentences.en: "I forgive you, Miss Havisham," said Pip.

sentences.en: Miss Havisham gave Pip a pencil, and she said, "Write under my name, 'I forgive her.'"

sentences.en: Pip went out to the garden, and he walked there for a while.

sentences.en: Soon he heard a shout, and he ran back to the house.

sentences.en: Miss Havisham's dress was on fire, and she ran to Pip with the fire around her.

sentences.en: Pip took a cloth from the table, and he put it over her.

sentences.en: He held her on the ground, and the fire went out, but his hands were burnt.

sentences.en: Men came, and they put Miss Havisham on the table where the cake had been.

sentences.en: Herbert came to the house, and he put cloths on Pip's hands.

sentences.en: Miss Havisham did not die for some days, and she said many times, "What have I done?"

sentences.en: She died, and she left most of her money to Estella.

sentences.en: A few days later, Pip went to Jaggers's office, and Wemmick was there.

sentences.en: Pip's hands were still in cloths, and Jaggers looked at them.

sentences.en: Jaggers gave Pip the 900 pounds from Miss Havisham, and Pip gave it to Clarriker for Herbert.

sentences.en: "Jaggers, I know who Estella's mother is," said Pip.

sentences.en: "Magwitch?" said Jaggers, and for the first time he did not know what to say.

sentences.en: "Prove it," said Jaggers.

sentences.en: "Magwitch had a girl, and her mother was angry, and she killed a woman," said Pip.

sentences.en: "Molly's hands are strong, and they have old cuts, and I saw them at your table."

sentences.en: "And I saw Molly's face, and it is the face of Estella."

sentences.en: Jaggers did not speak for a long time.

sentences.en: "I do not say that you are right," said Jaggers.

sentences.en: "Once I saved a woman in the court, and she gave up her child."

sentences.en: "Miss Havisham wanted a girl, and I gave her that child, and that is all I will say."

sentences.en: "I will not tell Estella," said Pip.

sentences.en: "That is good," said Jaggers.

sentences.en: Jaggers went to wash his hands, as he did when the talk was over.

sentences.en: Wemmick walked out with Pip, and he did not look stern now.

sentences.en: "Jaggers saved Molly, and she is a good woman now," said Wemmick.

sentences.en: "Keep it secret, Pip, for it will hurt many people."

sentences.en: "I say this in the street, and not in the office," said Wemmick.

sentences.en: "Pip, I have heard something."

sentences.en: "We will get Provis out of England soon," said Pip.

sentences.en: "Do it soon," said Wemmick.

sentences.en: Pip walked home, and he thought about Estella, the child of Molly and of the man by the river.

sentences.chapter: The Old House on the Marshes

sentences.en: Pip did not know who wrote it, but he was afraid for Provis.

sentences.en: "It was I who hit your sister, and it was your fault."

sentences.en: Pip thought about Joe and Biddy, and he was sorry that he had not been good to them.

sentences.en: Pip thought about Herbert and Estella, and he thought about Provis by the river.

sentences.en: "If I die, who will save Provis?" Pip thought.

sentences.en: Orlick drank from a bottle, and he came near.

sentences.en: Pip shouted for help, and the door of the house opened.

sentences.en: "We read your note," said Herbert, "and we came after you."

sentences.en: Pip's hands hurt, and he could not stand well, but he was safe.

sentences.en: Herbert took Pip back to the town, and they went home to London.

sentences.en: A week later, Wemmick sent a note to Pip.

sentences.en: In the morning, Provis came to the boat, and he wore a big coat and a hat.

sentences.en: Pip and Herbert and Startop began to row, and Provis sat in the back.

sentences.en: The river was wide, and there were many ships on it, and no one looked at them.

sentences.en: The water was cold, and the wind was strong, and Pip's hands hurt, but he did not stop.

sentences.en: "This is a good day, Pip," said Provis.

sentences.en: "I am with my boy, and I am on the water, and I am free."

sentences.en: They went on all day, and in the evening they came to a small inn near the sea.

sentences.en: "I have made you a gentleman," said Provis, "and now I will go away."

sentences.en: That night, Pip looked out of the window, and he saw a boat with 4 men on the river.

sentences.en: "Do not say a word," said Pip, "and we will go before they come back."

sentences.en: Pip did not sleep, and he looked at the river until the morning.

sentences.en: In the morning, they went out in the boat, and they came to the middle of the river.
